name: @pipeworx/mcp-fema-nfhl

tools.name: nfhl_flood_zone_at_point
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE flood-zone lookup: given a latitude/longitude, return the effective FEMA FIRM flood zone for that spot — the zone code (A, AE, AH, AO, VE, X, D), its subtype, whether it is in a Special Flood Hazard Area, the static base flood elevation, and the governing DFIRM id — plus nearby base flood elevation lines. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "is this address in a flood zone" or "does this property need flood insurance". Distinguishes "outside the floodplain" from "never mapped", which a plain empty result does not.

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (negative in the US)

include_bfe.description: Also return base flood elevation lines within ~150 m of the point. Default true.

tools.name: nfhl_query
tools.description: Query any layer of the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer with an ArcGIS WHERE clause and optional bounding box — flood hazard zones, base flood elevations, floodways, LOMRs and LOMAs, FIRM panels with their effective dates, levees, cross-sections, political jurisdictions. Use for area questions ("every floodway polygon in this county", "LOMRs issued on this DFIRM"). Layer ids come from nfhl_layers.

layer_id.description: NFHL layer id — 28 is Flood Hazard Zones, 16 Base Flood Elevations, 1 LOMRs, 3 FIRM Panels

where.description: ArcGIS WHERE clause, default "1=1". Id fields are strings: DFIRM_ID='48201C'.

bbox.description: Optional "xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax" WGS84 envelope to restrict the query (longitude first)

out_fields.description: Comma-separated field names, or "*" for all (default "*")

return_geometry.description: Include geometry. Default false — flood polygons are very large.

tools.name: nfhl_layers
tools.description: List every layer in the FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer MapServer with its id, name and geometry type, plus a plain-English guide to the layers that matter (flood hazard zones, base flood elevations, LOMRs, LOMAs, FIRM panels, levees, NFHL availability). Call this before nfhl_query.

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring to filter layer names, e.g. "flood", "levee"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fema-nfhl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fema-nfhl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
